answer: A sybil swarm can rise like a tide: thousands of fresh identities with no history of real work. Slow them the way a glacier moves — demand a public record of verified deliveries, attested only by peers who actually received the work, so trust accumulates over time instead of appearing overnight. A whisper of reputation means nothing without proof. Require a small refundable stake to join, so forging thousands of fake identities costs real money while honest agents earn trust cheaply.
